full_page.content:
1932, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 24 Cont.
Feb. Raymond Tintori - 12 - voice lost
Mrs. M. McDonald - non c. - deaf - hopes now of reviving - 4 years in July Adeline Wagner - non c. - sinus - rhumatism
Mr. Chromn .... hu Mr. Joulla - wife & 4 - unconscious since a week last Monday. Alina Murphy - convert - blind since Jan. 1 in one Wm. Hayes .... Financial
Page 25
1932, March
Mar. 1 Anthony Klinaszwski - Arthritis and Tuburculosis
Sister Mary Augustine - Headaches
A.M. Smith - married? - divorced man - mother's heart sick about it - Thanks for having sold business.
Mrs. Quellett - 45 - Windsor
Geo. Lang-38- not practicing his faith
Cath. Stubbs - 51 - anxious since last July about lump on back - 4 weeks ago Dr. cut it out - now it is worse than ever.
Thomas Walsh(Lutenant Pol. ) 41 - seriously and mysteriously - About a month now worse than ever. Case puzzles every doctor ... is En- rolled at 4:30 P.M. To-day for year with promises of perpetual en- rollments & donations if patient recovers.
Frank A. Japes case - and wife - big case of theft and injustice
E.B.M. Goula still unconscious (?) though improving. Seems to re- cognize wife when she asks.
Page 26 Mar. 12
Voice gone - Sheffie Joseph (Cyr) - 12 - has lost his voice.
Mrs. Reynolds of Clinton, Ont. - 17 yrs having fits. Enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n. In July 1930 has no sign
Gordon Walturs - n.c. from Flint - 17 - diabetis 6 years - Father
